sentences.text: In short: BONAVENTURA SALES AS is an established small company in "engroshandel med parfyme og kosmetikk" based in Oslo, profitable in 2025 and with no open NAV job ads under its org number.
BONAVENTURA SALES AS is registered in the industry "Engroshandel med parfyme og kosmetikk"; its registered activity is "Engroshandel med bredt utvalg av nærings- og nytelsesmidler.".
BONAVENTURA SALES AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2006-05-09, registered in Oslo.
It has 23 registered employees, reported revenue of NOK 553.61M for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 21.72M (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 3.9% and a moderate equity ratio of 36% of total assets.

Revenue fell 9.0% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 608.57M to NOK 553.61M); it was NOK 611.62M in 2023. The annual result was a profit in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: NOK 23.96M, 2024: NOK 26.48M, 2025: NOK 15.94M).
BONAVENTURA SALES AS is led by CEO Silje Løken and board chair Haraldur Reynir Jonsson.
It has a board of 2. The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2025-12-18 (within the past year).
BONAVENTURA SALES AS has 1 registered workplace.
